:::{#sol-rank-product-right-practice}

Each of the two [columns of $\matr{B}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) is $(1, 1)$,
so its [column space](#def-column-space) is $\operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 1)}$,
and @thm-rank-dim gives $\rankf{\matr{B}} = 1$.
By @thm-rank-product-right, $\rankf{\matr{A}\matr{B}} \le 1$
for every $3 \times 2$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$.

:::
